افترضتن (form VIII)
# اِفْتَرَضْتُنَّ (iftaraḍtunna) /if.ta.radˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past active of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
# اُفْتُرِضْتُنَّ (ufturiḍtunna) /uf.tu.ridˤ.tun.na/: second-person feminine plural past passive of اِفْتَرَضَ (iftaraḍa)
